providers.reason: RBC raised target to €48 (Outperform); ongoing buybacks (>3.5m shares) and strategic shift toward interventional imaging/Accela system provide support ahead of Nov 5 results.
providers.risk: Portfolio restructuring costs could pressure Q4 margins; mixed analyst reactions to ultrasound changes.

providers.reason: Technical indicators suggest a 'Strong Buy' signal as the stock trades near the lower end of its 52-week range. Despite Diagnostic segment headwinds, the Varian acquisition continues to drive growth in precision therapy, and recent FDA clearances for AI-powered imaging systems provide incremental innovation catalysts.
providers.risk: Prolonged weakness in the Chinese healthcare market and continued margin drag from the Diagnostics division.

providers.reason: Fresh RBC Outperform with target raised to €48 on the Accela radiotherapy launch, plus an ongoing buyback executed at rising prices (€41.50 on 16 Oct). The stock has broken its multi-year downtrend and the August highs on strong volume, with 7-day gains near 6% and healthcare defensiveness attractive in a wobbling tape.
providers.risk: Short-term overbought after a ~6% week and stalling near €43.75 resistance; a DAX risk-off day or profit-taking before the 5 Nov Q4 report could force a quick retest of €40.
